title: All products with their prices
question: Show all products: their code (MAHH), name (TENHH), unit price (DONGIA), and stock quantity (SLTON). Order by price descending.
hint: Use SELECT ... FROM HANG_HOA with ORDER BY

title: Products in a specific group
question: Find all products in the 'Thực phẩm' (Food) group. Show MAHH, TENHH, DONGIA. The group code for food is 'TP'.
hint: Use WHERE MANHOM = 'TP'

title: Products with group names
question: Show all products with their group name. Display MAHH, TENHH (as 'SanPham'), TENNHOM (as 'NhomHang'), and DONGIA.
solution:
SELECT h.MAHH, h.TENHH AS SanPham, n.TENNHOM AS NhomHang, h.DONGIA
FROM HANG_HOA h
JOIN NHOM_HANG n ON h.MANHOM = n.MANHOM
ORDER BY n.TENNHOM, h.MAHH;
hint: Use JOIN NHOM_HANG ON h.MANHOM = n.MANHOM

title: Products per group
question: Count how many products are in each product group. Show TENNHOM (group name) and the count (as 'SoLuong').
solution:
SELECT n.TENNHOM, COUNT(*) AS SoLuong
FROM HANG_HOA h
JOIN NHOM_HANG n ON h.MANHOM = n.MANHOM
GROUP BY n.TENNHOM;
hint: Use GROUP BY with COUNT(*)

title: Invoices in a date range
question: Show all invoices from February 2008. Display MAHD, NGAYLAP, TONGTIEN, and TENDL (agent name). Order by invoice code.
solution:
SELECT hd.MAHD, hd.NGAYLAP, hd.TONGTIEN, dl.TENDL
FROM HOA_DON hd
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL
WHERE hd.NGAYLAP >= '2008-02-01' AND hd.NGAYLAP < '2008-03-01'
ORDER BY hd.MAHD;
hint: Use WHERE NGAYLAP >= '2008-02-01' AND NGAYLAP < '2008-03-01'

title: Distinct product groups
question: Your inventory manager wants to know how many different product groups the company sells products in. Show all distinct group codes (MANHOM) from the product catalog. This gives an overview of which product categories are active.
hint: Use the DISTINCT keyword to remove duplicate values

title: Search agents by name
question: The sales team needs a list of agents whose name contains the phrase 'bách hóa' (general store). Show the agent code (MADL), name (TENDL), and address (DIACHI).
hint: Use WHERE TENDL LIKE with % wildcards around the search term

title: Packaging without secondary unit
question: Some packaging formats have a secondary packaging level (LOC) and some don't. Show all packaging formats that do NOT have a lốc (LOC) value — meaning they only sell by the thùng (case). Display MAHTDG and THUNG.
hint: Use WHERE LOC IS NULL to find rows with no LOC value

title: Products in selected groups
question: The marketing team is running a promotion and needs all products from the 'Bột' (BOT) and 'Thực phẩm' (TP) groups. Show MAHH, TENHH, and DONGIA. Use a single WHERE clause instead of multiple OR conditions.
hint: Use IN ('BOT', 'TP') instead of multiple OR conditions

title: Price statistics
question: The finance team needs a quick overview of the product pricing. Show the cheapest price (as 'GiaThapNhat'), the most expensive price (as 'GiaCaoNhat'), and the average price (as 'GiaTrungBinh') across all products.
solution:
SELECT MIN(DONGIA) AS GiaThapNhat, MAX(DONGIA) AS GiaCaoNhat, AVG(DONGIA) AS GiaTrungBinh
FROM HANG_HOA;
hint: Use MIN(), MAX(), and AVG() aggregate functions

title: Revenue by product group
question: Calculate total revenue (sum of THANHTIEN) for each product group. Show TENNHOM and total revenue (as 'DoanhThu'). Order by revenue descending.
solution:
SELECT n.TENNHOM, SUM(c.THANHTIEN) AS DoanhThu
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
JOIN NHOM_HANG n ON h.MANHOM = n.MANHOM
GROUP BY n.TENNHOM
ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC;
hint: Join CTHD → HANG_HOA → NHOM_HANG, then GROUP BY

title: Top 3 best-selling products
question: Find the top 3 products by total quantity sold (SLBAN). Show MAHH, TENHH, and total quantity sold (as 'TongSL').
solution:
SELECT h.MAHH, h.TENHH, SUM(c.SLBAN) AS TongSL
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
GROUP BY h.MAHH
ORDER BY TongSL DESC
LIMIT 3;
hint: Use SUM(c.SLBAN), GROUP BY, ORDER BY DESC, LIMIT 3

title: Employees grouped by role
question: For each employee type, show the role name (TENLOAI) and the number of employees (as 'SoNV'). Only include types that have at least 5 employees.
solution:
SELECT l.TENLOAI, COUNT(*) AS SoNV
FROM NHAN_VIEN e
JOIN LOAI_NV l ON e.MALNV = l.MALNV
GROUP BY l.TENLOAI
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
hint: Use HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 after GROUP BY

title: Invoice details with product and agent names
question: Show invoice details: MAHD, TENHH (product name), SLBAN (quantity sold), and TENDL (agent name). Join CTHD → HANG_HOA for product and CTHD → HOA_DON → DAI_LY for agent.
solution:
SELECT c.MAHD, h.TENHH, c.SLBAN, dl.TENDL
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL;
hint: You need 3 JOINs: CTHD → HANG_HOA, CTHD → HOA_DON, HOA_DON → DAI_LY

title: Invoices with high discounts
question: Find invoice details where the discount rate (CKBAN) is 20% or more. Show MAHD, TENHH (product name), SLBAN, CKBAN, THANHTIEN, and TENDL (agent name). Order by discount descending.
solution:
SELECT c.MAHD, h.TENHH, c.SLBAN, c.CKBAN, c.THANHTIEN, dl.TENDL
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL
WHERE c.CKBAN >= 0.20
ORDER BY c.CKBAN DESC;
hint: Filter with WHERE CKBAN >= 0.20

title: Products that have been sold
question: The warehouse manager wants to know which products have at least one sale. Show MAHH and TENHH for all products that appear in any invoice line item. Avoid listing the same product twice. Use a subquery instead of a JOIN.
hint: Use WHERE MAHH IN (SELECT DISTINCT MAHH FROM CTHD)

title: Employee invoice activity
question: The manager wants to review all employees and how many invoices each has created. Show MANV, HOTEN (employee name), and the number of invoices (as 'SoHoaDon'). Include employees who have not created any invoices. Order by invoice count ascending.
solution:
SELECT e.MANV, e.HOTEN, COUNT(hd.MAHD) AS SoHoaDon
FROM NHAN_VIEN e
LEFT JOIN HOA_DON hd ON e.MANV = hd.MANV
GROUP BY e.MANV
ORDER BY SoHoaDon ASC;
hint: Use LEFT JOIN to include employees with zero invoices

title: Products never sold
question: The product team is reviewing slow-moving inventory. Find products that have NEVER appeared in any invoice. Show MAHH and TENHH. Use NOT IN with a subquery.
hint: Use NOT IN with a subquery that selects MAHH from CTHD

title: Agents who have created invoices
question: The sales director needs a list of agents who HAVE created at least one invoice. Show MADL and TENDL. Use EXISTS with a correlated subquery.
hint: Use EXISTS with a correlated subquery referencing dl.MADL

title: Agents with no invoice activity
question: The sales director needs a list of agents who have NOT created any invoices. Show MADL and TENDL. Use NOT EXISTS with a correlated subquery.
hint: Use NOT EXISTS with a correlated subquery referencing dl.MADL

title: Monthly revenue in 2008
question: The finance team needs a monthly revenue report for 2008. Show each month (as 'Thang', format YYYY-MM) and the total invoice value (as 'DoanhThu'). Order by month. Hint: Use substr(NGAYLAP, 1, 7) to extract the year-month part of the date.
solution:
SELECT substr(NGAYLAP, 1, 7) AS Thang, SUM(TONGTIEN) AS DoanhThu
FROM HOA_DON
WHERE NGAYLAP >= '2008-01-01' AND NGAYLAP < '2009-01-01'
GROUP BY Thang
ORDER BY Thang;
hint: Use substr(NGAYLAP, 1, 7) to extract YYYY-MM and GROUP BY to aggregate

title: Above average for their group
question: Find products whose price is higher than the AVERAGE price of products in their OWN group. For example, a product in 'Bột' should be compared only to the average of 'Bột', not the overall average. Show MAHH, TENHH, MANHOM, DONGIA.
solution:
SELECT h.MAHH, h.TENHH, h.MANHOM, h.DONGIA
FROM HANG_HOA h
WHERE h.DONGIA > (
  SELECT AVG(DONGIA)
  FROM HANG_HOA
  WHERE MANHOM = h.MANHOM
);
hint: Use a correlated subquery: the inner WHERE references the outer table's MANHOM

title: Products above average price
question: Find products whose price (DONGIA) is higher than the average price of all products. Show MAHH, TENHH, DONGIA.
hint: Use WHERE DONGIA > (SELECT AVG(DONGIA) FROM HANG_HOA)

title: Highest-spending agent
question: Which agent (TENDL) spent the most total money across all invoices? Show TENDL and total spent (as 'TongChiTieu'). Order by total descending, limit 1.
solution:
SELECT dl.TENDL, SUM(c.THANHTIEN) AS TongChiTieu
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL
GROUP BY dl.MADL
ORDER BY TongChiTieu DESC
LIMIT 1;
hint: Use 3 JOINs, GROUP BY agent, ORDER BY SUM, LIMIT 1

title: Team revenue ranking
question: Calculate total revenue generated by each team. Show MADOI (team code) and total revenue (as 'DoanhThu'). Only include teams that have generated revenue. Order by revenue descending.
solution:
SELECT e.MADOI, SUM(c.THANHTIEN) AS DoanhThu
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
JOIN NHAN_VIEN e ON hd.MANV = e.MANV
WHERE e.MADOI IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.MADOI
ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC;
hint: Join CTHD → HOA_DON → NHAN_VIEN, filtering out NULL teams with WHERE e.MADOI IS NOT NULL

title: Agents buying from all groups
question: Find agents who have purchased products from ALL product groups. This is a relational division problem: there should NOT exist a product group that the agent has NOT purchased from. Show MADL and TENDL. Use double NOT EXISTS.
solution:
SELECT dl.MADL, dl.TENDL
FROM DAI_LY dl
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT nh.MANHOM
  FROM NHOM_HANG nh
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM CTHD c
    JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
    JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
    WHERE hd.MADL = dl.MADL
      AND h.MANHOM = nh.MANHOM
  )
);
hint: Use double NOT EXISTS: 'there is no product group that this agent has not bought from'

title: Product pairs in the same group
question: The product manager wants to see all possible pairs of products that belong to the same group for cross-promotion. Show both product names (as 'SP1' and 'SP2') and the shared group name (as 'NhomHang'). Each pair should appear only once. Use a self-join.
solution:
SELECT a.TENHH AS SP1, b.TENHH AS SP2, n.TENNHOM AS NhomHang
FROM HANG_HOA a
JOIN HANG_HOA b ON a.MANHOM = b.MANHOM AND a.MAHH < b.MAHH
JOIN NHOM_HANG n ON a.MANHOM = n.MANHOM
ORDER BY n.TENNHOM, a.TENHH;
hint: Self-join HANG_HOA on MANHOM with a.MAHH < b.MAHH to avoid duplicate pairs

title: Average revenue per employee
question: Management wants to know the average revenue generated per employee. First calculate each employee's total revenue (from invoice line items), then find the average across all employees. Show the result as 'DoanhThuTrungBinh'. Include employees with zero revenue. Use a derived table (subquery in FROM).
solution:
SELECT AVG(emp_rev) AS DoanhThuTrungBinh
FROM (
  SELECT e.MANV, COALESCE(SUM(c.THANHTIEN), 0) AS emp_rev
  FROM NHAN_VIEN e
  LEFT JOIN HOA_DON hd ON e.MANV = hd.MANV
  LEFT JOIN CTHD c ON hd.MAHD = c.MAHD
  GROUP BY e.MANV
);
hint: Use a subquery in FROM to calculate per-employee revenue first, then average the results

title: Products never sold at deep discount
question: The pricing team wants to find products that have NEVER been sold at a discount rate above 15% (CKBAN > 0.15). Show MAHH and TENHH. Use a correlated NOT EXISTS subquery.
solution:
SELECT h.MAHH, h.TENHH
FROM HANG_HOA h
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM CTHD c
  JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
  WHERE c.MAHH = h.MAHH
    AND c.CKBAN > 0.15
);
hint: Use NOT EXISTS with a correlated subquery: c.MAHH = h.MAHH

title: Top agents by group coverage and spending
question: The sales VP wants to identify top-performing agents. Find agents who have purchased from more than 2 different product groups AND have total spending (sum of THANHTIEN) over 1,000,000 VND. Show MADL, TENDL, number of groups (as 'SoNhom'), and total spending (as 'TongChiTieu').
solution:
SELECT dl.MADL, dl.TENDL, COUNT(DISTINCT h.MANHOM) AS SoNhom, SUM(c.THANHTIEN) AS TongChiTieu
FROM CTHD c
JOIN HOA_DON hd ON c.MAHD = hd.MAHD
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL
JOIN HANG_HOA h ON c.MAHH = h.MAHH
GROUP BY dl.MADL
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.MANHOM) > 2
   AND SUM(c.THANHTIEN) > 1000000
ORDER BY TongChiTieu DESC;
hint: Use GROUP BY agent with HAVING that has TWO conditions: group count > 2 AND total > 1000000

title: Custom invoice sorting
question: The accountant has a special request: show all invoices but with a custom sort order. Agent 'Cửa hàng tổng hợp DDC' (DL003) should appear first (they are a VIP client), followed by all other agents ordered by invoice total descending. Show MAHD, TENDL, and TONGTIEN. Use CASE in ORDER BY.
solution:
SELECT hd.MAHD, dl.TENDL, hd.TONGTIEN
FROM HOA_DON hd
JOIN DAI_LY dl ON hd.MADL = dl.MADL
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN dl.MADL = 'DL003' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  hd.TONGTIEN DESC;
hint: Use CASE in ORDER BY to assign sort priority: 0 for VIP agent (DL003), 1 for everyone else
